evidence: Carries the 'Private Broadcast' label and changes transaction relay behavior under '-privatebroadcast' by withholding unconfirmed wallet transactions from peer announcement and retrieval.
rationale: Stops nodes running '-privatebroadcast' from deanonymizing themselves over clearnet by serving dropped unconfirmed transactions that only they hold. P2P treats transaction origin privacy as a high priority, and rebroadcasting dropped transactions undermines the privacy guarantee of the private broadcast feature.
